staffPage.roleHintStaff: Staff can take and cancel orders, manage tables, view live orders. Cannot remove orders, change menu items, or modify store settings.
staffPage.roleHintAdmin: Restaurant Admin has full access: remove orders, edit menu and recipes, change store settings, manage staff, view all reports.
staffPage.linkedNoPin: Signs in with their own account and switches to this store — no Staff ID or PIN.
staffPage.inviteTitle: Invite an existing account as staff
staffPage.inviteHint: This person already has a PurpleHere account. They accept on their role selection screen, then sign in with their own password and switch to this store. Staff ID and PIN are not used.
staffPage.inviteSent: Invitation sent. They will appear in this list once they accept.
staffPage.emailExistsInvite: This email already has a PurpleHere account. Invite it to join this store as staff?
staffPage.unlinkConfirm: this account will lose access to this store. Their own account stays as it is.
staffPage.attendanceLinkHelp: Attendance only counts staff added here. Give each person a 4-digit PIN — they type it on the Time Clock. When you are done, go back to Attendance.
